highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m155 with GLES interop and HarfBuzz refreshes.
highlights_body: The release also disables RAW and DNG image decoding and incorporates upstream m155 servicing fixes.

breaking.title: RAW and DNG image decoding disabled
breaking.body: RAW and DNG images are no longer decoded by the bundled engine. Use another decoder or convert those images before loading them with SkiaSharp.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Skia m155 and incorporates the current upstream bug and servicing fixes.
Updates the managed GLES interop surface to use pointer-based signatures for native interoperability.

preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14: Preview 1 opened the 4.155 line with the Skia m155 engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13: Preview 2 added m155 servicing fixes, pointer-based GLES interop, and the HarfBuzz 14.4.0 update.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8: Release Candidate 1 incorporated the latest m155 servicing fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine and managed binding to version 14.4.0.

v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m155 renderer update.

v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 Preview 2 adds m155 servicing fixes and updated interop.
v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.body: It refreshes HarfBuzzSharp to version 14.4.0 and disables RAW and DNG image decoding.

v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 Release Candidate 1 incorporates the latest m155 servicing fixes.
